sections.title: HARBETH SUPERHL5
sections.overview: This is a speaker system developed with Havez technology as a speaker that inherits the design philosophy of HL5.For the low range, we have adopted a 20 cm cone type woofer using RADIAL cone which was completed after repeated trial and error through technical exchange with material manufacturers and university laboratories since the 90's.This unit adjusts the amount of aluminum while taking advantage of the advantages of polypropylene. Moreover, by changing the blend from the center to the periphery of the diaphragm, various problems that occur on the surface of the cone in the middle and low band and middle and high band are reduced.Harvez has introduced high-precision molding equipment for the production of this cone and is focusing on the development of driver units with physical properties superior to those of ordinary vacuum molded polypropylene cones. Has achieved units with excellent characteristics.A 2.5 cm diameter aluminum hard dome type tweeter is used for the high frequency band.Ferrofluid cooling treatment is applied so that sound does not collapse even at high temperature. It is a custom-made model by SEAS based on Havez specifications in order to support a wide range of digital sources.The Super HL5 is equipped with a super tweeter for the first time in the history of the HL family.The unit is a 2 cm hard dome type super tweeter with titanium diaphragm, and the resolution and air feeling are improved by receiving the high frequency of 10 khz or more.In addition, a neodymium magnet is used for the magnetic circuit.The crossover network is designed by Alan Shaw with a computer grade board and other carefully selected minimal parts, and the circuit is mounted after computer testing and listening.The speaker terminal supports a banana plug for bi-wiring connection.In order to realize the "Havez sound", the enclosure design employs the Super Tuned Structure technology, which eliminates unwanted resonance in the mid-frequency range from the material by tuning the mass and compliance of the material, and tunes the material by computer analysis so that very thin material can respond quickly to the sound energy.In addition, by using high hardness and thin materials with different resonance and stiffness, and by using a unique approach to adjust the overall tone while damping with a tar-based material with multiple layers of these materials, unnecessary resonance is damped at high speed by the physical properties of the material itself and its combination, rather than being suppressed by weight and rigidity.The edge of the front baffle is rounded to reduce acoustic diffraction, and the front baffle groove is embedded with a Jersey grill to enhance enclosure integration and reduce the impact on sound quality with SuperGrille.It is finished with cherry finish.A special speaker stand is sold separately.

sections.title: HARBETH HLCOMPACT7
sections.overview: This is a speaker system that has been thoroughly reviewed in pursuit of realism and clarity by further polishing the beautiful sound unique to Havez.A 20 cm cone woofer with a newly designed original diaphragm is mounted in the low range.This cone uses a diaphragm manufacturing method that blends three types of polymers and arranges them from the center to the periphery, solving the problem of different cone surfaces near the center and at the periphery.In addition, the voice coil has a unique structure with air permeability in mind to stabilize temperature characteristics over a long period of time.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is a hard dome type evaporated on a unique T-yoke, and uses ferrofluid cooling to facilitate heat diffusion at high temperature of voice coil by applying magnetic oil.A unique Super Tuned Structure (STS) is introduced in the enclosure design. By using a special sandwich structure in which multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness are layered between hard MDF materials, unwanted vibrations are damped while making use of the sound by combining with the physical properties of the material itself rather than weight or rigidity.The bass reflex port of the enclosure is made into a square shape based on repeated trial listening, and important parts inside the enclosure are dumped with tar material.The Frameless Frame method is used for the net grill. A different jersey material is used for the net grill. The frame of the grill is fitted into the groove of the baffle to improve the integration with the enclosure, thereby minimizing the influence on the high frequency range.There was a special stand sold separately.

sections.title: HARBETH HLCOMPACT7ES-2
sections.overview: While inheriting the musicality of HL Compact and HL Compact 7, this speaker system was refined by technical exchange with engineers of BBC.A 20 cm cone type speaker unit with a RADIAL cone is used for the low range.While taking advantage of the advantages of polypropylene, this cone optimizes the amount of aluminum, and by changing the amount of blend from the center of the diaphragm to the periphery, it reduces various problems that occur on the cone surface in the middle and low band and middle and high band.In addition, in the HL Compact 7ES-2, in partnership with BBS engineers, the RADIAL cone has been further polished to improve reproducibility in a compact enclosure.A 2.5 cm hard dome type tweeter is used for the high range.The diaphragm is made of aluminum and has a high input resistant design.The network uses carefully selected top-quality parts, including computer-grade fiberglass substrates.The assembled circuit is tested one by one by computer, and after the matching is made, the trial listening is repeated and mounted.The speaker terminal can be bi-wired and can be connected to a banana plug.The enclosure is designed in accordance with the BBC tradition with removable front and rear baffles to create a lossy coupling structure.In addition, by creating a sandwich structure in which multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness are layered between hard materials, resonance is damped not by weight or rigidity but by the physical properties of the material itself and its combination.In addition, we have adopted the Super Tuned Structure, which is tuned based on computer analysis so that thin materials can react quickly to the sound energy rather than making the structure thick and difficult to control. By tuning the mass and compliance of the materials, we have succeeded in eliminating unwanted resonance in the especially important mid-range from the materials.The edges of the front baffle have been rounded to reduce acoustic diffraction at the edges.The jersey grill is installed using a method called SuperGrille, which is embedded in the groove of the front baffle to enhance the sense of unity with the enclosure and reduce the effect on sound quality.Not only does it protect the driver unit, but it is designed to listen when normally worn with a grill that smooths out the sound radiation.The exterior is a cheek finish.

sections.title: HARBETH HLCOMPACT7ES-3
sections.overview:
173,250 (tax included, 1 unit, released in 2006)

This is a speaker system that was created by flash-up to further enhance the perfection of the HLCompact 7ES-2.A 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit uses the RADIAL2 technology, which is an improved version of the RADIAL technology used in the L-Compact7ES-2.At RADIAL, various problems on the cone surface in each frequency band were reduced by introducing special molding equipment and by changing the blend from the center to the periphery of several types of polymers with optimum characteristics for each frequency band based on lightweight but robust polypropylene.In order to maximize its performance, the RADIAL2 uses a soft and contractible edge. The sound does not become distorted even when the piston motion is large, resulting in a flatter and more natural performance. In particular, linearity is improved at high power input. This reduces the reflection from the edge back to the voice coil, smoothes the high-band reproducibility of the unit, and allows for finer mid-range playback.A 2.5 cm diameter aluminum hard dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.By applying magnetic oil, it is subjected to ferrofluid cooling treatment which can maintain stable regeneration ability even in high temperature, and by using synthetic resin for the edge, more accurate reproducibility is obtained.In addition, the newly designed Open Weave Grill improves the energy and spaciousness of the high-frequency range.The network section has been redesigned with a newly introduced computer design system. The final sound is determined by listening tests conducted by the ears of the designer Alan Shaw. The design emphasizes not only data but also audibility.The enclosure uses a unique design technology, SuperTunedStructure, which is based on computer analysis of sound behavior in the enclosure and optimizes response tuning of the enclosure using thin wood to improve sound quality.In addition, we aim to further improve the transit characteristics by dampening with bitumen (bitumen system) instead of bracing for internal reinforcement of wood.In addition, by setting the bass reflex port longer, the resonance frequencies of the port are lowered, the response in the low range is improved, and the power feeling in the middle range is improved. In addition, a round baffle for reducing the sound wave diffraction at the baffle end and SuperGrille's method for optimizing sound wave propagation by embedding a jersey grill in the front baffle are also adopted.The input terminal is not a by-wire connection specification but a single connection specification for gold-plated banana plug.

Referring to the manufacturing method of string instruments such as violins and acoustic techniques, by layering multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness between hard materials, unwanted resonance is damped by the physical properties of the materials themselves and their combination.The grill adopts the Frameless Frame method adopted in HL Compact7.The frame edge of the grille made of jersey material fits snugly into the groove of the front baffle to improve the integrity of the enclosure and improve sound reflection to improve directional characteristics and sound image localization.

sections.overview: LS5/12A Grade1 Miniature Monitor Loudspeaker developed by the BBC as a new reference for small speakers. Grade1 means the highest grade monitor speaker used for sound check before sending from the studio to the transmitter. LS5/8, LS5/9, LS5/12A etc. were used.By the way, LS3/5A is a grade 2 for checking speech program.A 11.5 cm cone type woofer of 15W7508BBC (made by Dynaudio) is used for the low band.A 7.5 cm large diameter aluminum voice coil is used to obtain stable reproducibility.A 2.8 cm diameter dome type tweeter D-260BBC (manufactured by Dynaudio) is used for the high-frequency band.Ferrofluid cooling is used in this unit, and magnetic oil is applied to the voice coil to enhance its durability by promoting thermal diffusion when the voice coil becomes hot.In addition, excellent transients and low distortion are obtained by carefully molding and damping the rear chamber.The unit uses a sealed magnet to prevent magnetic flux leakage, and can be used as a TV monitor.The network section can be simplified by smoothing the characteristics of the unit, eliminating the complex characteristic correction network, using top-grade components such as air-core inductors, and using 5-ounce copper instead of the usual 1-ounce substrate.The enclosure has been designed based on CAD, with particular attention paid to the rear bass reflex port, which has an unusually large diameter relative to the enclosure size, and has optimized shape and structure to improve the bass response in order to obtain rich bass from a small volume.The front baffle has been rounded to prevent acoustic wave diffraction.It has a rosewood finish.The speaker terminal is bi-wired and has banana plug specifications.Each unit has smooth characteristics and allowable input, and meets the standard of tolerance of 0.25 dB or less.The final balance of the system is optimized by intensive listening with experts from various fields gathered in the BBC studio and comparing the speaker output with the sound of live performance. The system is polished with an emphasis on reproducibility under actual operating conditions as well as theoretical measurements in an anechoic room.

sections.title: HARMAN_KARDON Harman
sections.overview: This speaker system improves the time it takes to reach the listener by improving the line arrangement of the speaker unit.In Reference I, the V-line arrangement is adopted for the unit layout. The woofer unit of the long travel voice coil is placed in the center, and the short travel voice coil is placed outside the center.As a result, the difference in time between the sound coming from each unit and reaching the listener's ear is minimized, and the phase characteristic is improved by shortening the time difference between units.The unit is a 4-speaker configuration with a 27.4 cm polypropylene cone woofer for the low range, a 13.7 cm polypropylene cone squaker for the middle range, and a double ribbon tweeter for the high range.The enclosure has a walnut oil finish.

sections.title: HARMAN_KARDON Harman
sections.overview: A speaker system with an ambience control mounted on the rear rotating baffle under the theme of sound field control suitable for the room.It is equipped with a 21.1 cm polypropylene cone type woofer in the low range and a 2.54 cm polypropylene dome type tweeter in the high range.A 6.5 cm cone type rear tweeter is mounted on the rear rotating baffle for ambience control. The angle of this unit can be controlled depending on whether it is placed vertically or horizontally.Internal faders allow you to adjust the energy levels of the front and rear speakers, allowing you to further control the ambience effect.The enclosure has a walnut wood-grain finish.

sections.title: HINOAUDIO Hino
sections.overview: A speaker system that reproduces JBL's Paragon in 42/100 scale.A 16 cm cone type woofer made by JBL is mounted in the low range.Polypropylene cone is used for the diaphragm of the unit, and degradation due to aging is little, and initial performance can be maintained over a long period of time.The high-frequency band is equipped with a miniH5038P horn, an aluminum die-cast horn that is scaled down from the Paragon H5038P, and a titanium aluminate tweeter.A horn type super tweeter, 816 dt 01, is mounted in the super high frequency range.Wood is used for the enclosure. YonematsuThe Paragon enclosure creates a unique sound field by widely dispersing sound waves emitted from the left and right sides by a centrally located refractor panel. In addition, the long sound path is combined into a small space by storing the S-shaped horn part behind the refractor panel.The exterior features a walnut natural wood finish.The terminal uses Hino Audio's original speaker terminal T-50, which can be connected to speaker cables up to 6 mm in diameter. Thick gold plating on brass prevents deterioration of sound quality due to aging.In addition, by adopting a highly accurate clamp type, loosening caused by vibration is minimized.
